Run insertion-ordered map callbacks and the PrintWriter access registration, and update the real StringBuffer backing bytes for bounded character ranges. Physical and native controls covered conflicting inverse writes, escaped order, colliding identity hashes, LinkedHashSet mutation, independent streams and a reversed pair of JARs.
